note: Data for retention.py: thresholds and the words that identify columns in a YouTube Studio export, in Russian and English. Matching is on lower-cased header text, by substring.
hook_note: The hook is hook_share of the video, at least hook_min_seconds and at most hook_seconds: from 5 minutes up that is 30 s as in the original, a 60 s Short gets 6 s. PRELIMINARY - to be checked on the owner's Studio exports.
headers_status: NOT CONFIRMED on a real export. English names seen in third-party code: 'Video position (%)', 'Absolute audience retention (%)', and a separate segment table with 'Started watching', 'Stopped watching', 'Number of times each moment was seen'. Russian names are guesses until a real Russian-UI export is checked.
